comment: Part 1 deploy SPEC for the future, separately authorized Part 2 upload. This file authorizes nothing and no upload has been performed from it. Secret VALUES never appear here.

secret_bindings_required.name: OPALREADER_ACCESS_TOKEN
secret_bindings_required.source: Set by Julie in the Cloudflare dashboard at Part 2 time. Must be a DISTINCT staging-only value; never copied from the v1 script by tooling (secret values are unreadable between scripts).

smoke_r2_namespace.note: B7 revision (Rowan 6345016639): every R2 read/write from this staging script is prefixed smoke-p8/ (worker-entry -> createR2AudioCache keyPrefix), a namespace non-overlapping with production audio keys (audio/<cacheKey>.<ext>) in the shared bucket. The production key shape is unchanged; the future production configuration sets no prefix. B7 safety round (Rowan 6346291349): the prefix is also enforced in code — under staging-smoke scope, OpalReaderCoordinator._cache() refuses to construct the cache unless R2_KEY_PREFIX is exactly smoke-p8/, failing closed (staging_r2_namespace_required) before any bucket operation, so isolation does not depend on error-free upload metadata.

workers_dev_subdomain.note: A new script's workers.dev subdomain starts disabled via the API; Part 2 enables it once after upload.
